lanes.summary: I found nothing that refutes the diff against PMAT-1548. The Cargo.lock diff only touches the packages the ticket names: rustls-webpki 0.103.16, webpki-roots and webpki-root-certs 1.0.11, tokio 1.53.3, libz-sys 1.1.31, pulldown-cmark 0.13.5 and zstd-sys 2.1.2. No other dependency edge moves, so the lockfile is surgical. The four ignores (RUSTSEC-2026-0387/0391/0398/0403) are exactly the ones the ticket lists. They appear in both deny.toml and .cargo/audit.toml, and each has a reason. The lock still pins crypto-bigint 0.5.5, zstd 0.13.3 and zstd-safe 7.2.4, which matches the claim that only upstream major bumps fix them. octocrab is optional behind `github-api`, and github_client.rs builds the client with `.personal_token(token)`, which supports the reachability argument for 0387. No gate is weakened and no test is touched. I could not check the claim that `cargo deny check advisories` and `cargo audit` report no errors: this lane may not run them, and the receipt gives no recorded gate result. That claim is asserted, not refuted. There are two minor non-blocking notes below. I found no paiml-lane-witness file in the worktree git dir, so tree_witness is left out.

findings.claim: The RUSTSEC-2026-0391 comment says the fix 'needs zstd>=0.14.3 via an aprender-common upstream bump; mirrors deny.toml'. The deny.toml reason names both aprender-common and batuta-common, and Cargo.lock shows both depend on zstd (lines 259 and 905). So the audit.toml comment does not fully mirror deny.toml. This is documentation drift only and has no effect on the gate.
findings.fix: Name batuta-common in the audit.toml comment as well.

findings.claim: A second pulldown-cmark 0.9.6 stays in the lock. It is pulled in by another crate (around Cargo.lock:5911), and the diff only bumps 0.13.4 to 0.13.5. If the pulldown-cmark advisory's affected range covers 0.9.x, cargo deny/audit would still fail. The ticket's 'no errors (measured)' claim says it does not, but this lane could not run the tools to confirm.
findings.fix: Attach the cargo deny/cargo audit output to the receipt so the 'no errors' claim is backed by evidence.

findings.claim: Supports the 0387 ignore reason: the client is built with `Octocrab::builder().personal_token(token)`, and octocrab is optional (`github-api = ["octocrab"]`, Cargo.toml:618). No JWT/app auth path was found.
